description: LCP, INP and CLS, judged at the 75th percentile of real visits. Good: LCP ≤ 2.5 s, INP ≤ 200 ms, CLS ≤ 0.1.
Largest Contentful Paint: the time the largest visible text block or image is painted. The last candidate before the first user input counts.
Interaction to Next Paint: the slowest interaction of the visit, from input to the next frame. Field only; TBT is its lab proxy.
Total Blocking Time: the sum of the time over 50 ms of every long task between FCP and Time to Interactive.
Time to First Byte (server, network, CDN) and First Contentful Paint (first text or image). Diagnostic metrics that explain LCP.
Metrics from real users, collected with `PerformanceObserver` or the `web-vitals` library, or read from the Chrome UX Report (CrUX).
Repeatable runs in a controlled environment: Lighthouse, WebPageTest, the DevTools Performance panel. Explains causes, cannot measure INP.
